{{Top|leg}}
'''Processing Center 7''' was a [[zinsian]] processing plant on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Brosi]]. The [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] forces on the planet, led by [[Abil Vilorin]], infiltrated a trio of [[operative]]s into Processing Center 7 during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].
